findings.evidence: Zero interpolations of inputs.*, github.ref_name/head_ref/base_ref/event, or steps.*.outputs into any run body across all workflows and actions. Values arrive through env blocks (21 of 28 release run steps declare one). actionlint reports no untrusted-input findings. The one pre-existing site, maven.yml's List m2 step, was removed in 6.1.

findings.item: Release App permissions and token renewal
findings.evidence: Three token generations: initial checkout, before post-gate writes, and for cleanup. A missing credential is named before create-github-app-token runs. The token is written into the git remote url rather than a command line, and the token action masks it. It is never echoed and never written to a step output.
No ACTIONS_KEY and no ssh-key remain in any workflow or action. maven.yml's checkout key was removed in 6.1 because development CI no longer pushes.

Branch advancement uses ordinary non-forced pushes with an expected-tip check. Cleanup reverts with --force-with-lease against the sha this run pushed, so the compare-and-reset is atomic at the remote. Tag and branch deletion compare the exact recorded object first. A GitHub Release is deleted by recorded id, or resolved by tag only when creation was attempted but unconfirmed.

authorize-security-group-ingress is not suffixed with || true. A duplicate rule is recognised and left alone; any other error fails. Only a rule this run created is revoked, on success or failure. A revoke failure is reported, not hidden. Confirmed live: 'Added ingress for 132.196.62.67/32. This run owns that rule and will remove it.'

The client certificate list is scoped to the Postman environment's host and port only, so requests to no_cert_host carry no certificate and the Hub's certificate fallback cannot mask an expired-token rejection. The key file and the passphrase-bearing list are written 0600 and deleted by verify-hub with if: always().

Release-path artifacts are allowlisted: the dependency-check report, and verify-hub's ./testing/logs. verify-hub deletes the key, certificate, and certificate list before any caller can upload them. maven.yml retains path: . on failure by maintainer decision. Accepted because the repository is public, so its tracked files including conf/ssl are already world-readable, and the artifact adds only target/ build output. No credential file exists in the build job's workspace; Maven settings.xml and toolchains.xml live under ~/.m2, outside it.
No change. No application code, keystore format, provider, or authorization path was modified by this change. The only non-workflow source edit is the pom.xml <name> element.

security_review.notes: One weakening was accepted deliberately and is recorded in open_items: OSS Index is disabled in both scans because the configured Sonatype credentials are rejected. NVD analysis is unaffected.
